description: This file defines the interface for the ocudulog logging framework, including functions for managing log channels, loggers, formatters, sinks, and framework initialization. It declares functions, templates, and classes related to logging operations and configuration.

methods.name: find_log_channel
methods.description: Finds a log channel by its id string, returning a pointer if found or nullptr otherwise.

methods.name: fetch_log_channel
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a log channel with the specified id, optionally with a sink and configuration.

methods.name: create_log_channel
methods.description: Creates and registers a new log channel with the given id and sink; deprecated in favor of fetch_log_channel.

methods.name: find_logger
methods.description: Finds a logger of a specific type by id, returning a pointer or nullptr.

methods.name: fetch_basic_logger
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a basic logger with the specified id, optionally with a sink and context printing.

methods.name: fetch_logger
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a logger of a specific type with the given id and arguments.

methods.name: create_basic_logger
methods.description: Creates and registers a new basic logger; deprecated in favor of fetch_basic_logger.

methods.name: set_default_log_formatter
methods.description: Sets the default log formatter used by new sinks.

methods.name: get_default_log_formatter
methods.description: Returns the current default log formatter.

methods.name: create_text_formatter
methods.description: Creates a new plain text formatter.

methods.name: create_contextual_text_formatter
methods.description: Creates a new plain text formatter that adds context.

methods.name: create_json_formatter
methods.description: Creates a new JSON formatter.

methods.name: set_default_sink
methods.description: Sets the default sink for log channels and loggers.

methods.name: get_default_sink
methods.description: Returns the current default sink.

methods.name: find_sink
methods.description: Finds a sink by its id string.

methods.name: fetch_stdout_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sink that writes to stdout.

methods.name: fetch_stderr_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a sink that writes to stderr.

methods.name: fetch_file_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a file sink with specified path and options.

methods.name: fetch_syslog_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a syslog sink with specified parameters.

methods.name: fetch_udp_sink
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a UDP socket sink.

methods.name: install_custom_sink
methods.description: Installs a user-defined sink with a specific id.

methods.name: create_file_sink
methods.description: Creates a file sink; deprecated in favor of fetch_file_sink.

methods.name: create_stdout_sink
methods.description: Creates a stdout sink; deprecated in favor of fetch_stdout_sink.

methods.name: create_stderr_sink
methods.description: Creates a stderr sink; deprecated in favor of fetch_stderr_sink.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the logging framework.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes all registered sinks.

methods.name: set_error_handler
methods.description: Sets the error handler for the framework.
